questions.question:
**In the following question, some parts of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate**** ****option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

Sameer is the most succeeded of all (1)/ the businessmen (2)/ in this city today. (3)/ No Error (4)

options.text: Sameer is the most succeeded of all

questions.solution:
The error is in part** 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here the error lies in the usage of the word **"succeeded" **in its place "**successful**" will be used.
 
• **succeeded**(**verb**) is wrong here because we are not showing any working activity.
 
• **successful**(**adjective**) will be used here because we are showing the quality of businessmen.

Hence, the correct sentence will be:-Sameer is the most** successful** of all the businessmen in this city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Verb-** these are the words that **show the time **in the sentence. They are also used to tell us about **something is happening** in the sentence. Eg: Run(Ram runs), Flies(Plane flies), Slept(Sita slept).
 
• **Adjective- **these are the words that qualify Noun or Pronoun in a sentence. Eg: Large(Large man), Heavy(Heavy man)

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and**** ****indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.** 

One must do ______ duty.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. __One's__**

__
 
• The entire sentence must be in the same tone. The usage of *one *must be followed uniformly in the entire sentence.
 
• The possessive form of the subject **'One'** is **one's**__.

Hence, the correct sentence after filling the blank will be- *"One must do **one's **duty."*

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.** 

Clasp
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Catch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Clasp"** means to grasp (something) tightly with one's hand. (पकड़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** She clasped her mother's hand tightly.
 
 
 
• **"Catch"** refers to the act of seizing or holding something. (पकड़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to catch the ball just before it hit the ground.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Catch**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Loose** (ढीला): Not firmly or tightly fixed in place.
 
 
• **Example:** His shoelaces were loose and he tripped over them.
 
 
 
• **Let go** (छोड़ देना): To release one's grip on something.
 
 
• **Example:** He finally let go of the grudge he had been holding.
 
 
 
• **Release** (रिहा करना): To allow something to move, act, or flow freely.
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to release the new product next month.

questions.question: important and ______ person.
questions.solution:
Correct answer is option 2) __**Useful**__

The word "useful" when describing a person generally means that they provide a beneficial service or fulfill an important role. When referring to a doctor, they definitely fulfill an important and beneficial role as they diagnose illnesses, prescribe medications, and save lives, which are all extremely "useful" services to society.

The other options do not fit in this context. "Reusable" and "usable" are typically not used to describe a person and do not fit the context.
